web/src/features/plan: The plan page's notes are review threads: it mounts the review's thread panel and composer on its own scope, sends its notes and sign-offs as review ops, keeps its draft as the review keeps one, reads the project's review file at the pulse's revision, and links each scene to the newest render's snapshot.
web/src/features/decisions: A decision's candidates each have a review thread: the decisions page mounts the review's thread panel on its own thread scope, its notes sent as review ops and its draft kept as the review keeps one.
